release_slices.name: F&B import and item image upload hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Stop F&B CSV imports from failing rows with database operation timeouts and make item image upload failures clear and recoverable.
release_slices.purpose: Stabilize F&B item import and Storefront Catalog item image upload without changing payments, checkout totals, POS shift rules, or tenant lifecycle behavior.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Caps row-level CSV import writes to reduce tenant database pool pressure, maps Multer upload-limit errors to client-visible 4xx responses, retries Storefront catalog image override writes without the gallery payload when tenant schemas lag the gallery column, updates targeted backend regression tests, corrects the stale POS terminal contract label expectation, and records compliance impact for the POS-sensitive test file.
included_features: Client-safe item image upload error mapping
Regression tests for import concurrency, upload error mapping, and image repository fallback
Compliance declaration for the POS-sensitive contract-test correction
excluded_features: Checkout totals, payment handling, fiscal receipt calculation, shift-opening logic, and tenant lifecycle changes
Production deployment outside the signed controller
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: CSV imports may process large update/product batches more slowly, and tenants missing the image-gallery column may temporarily store primary image data without gallery metadata until schema catch-up.

release_slices.slice_name: Authentication account switch and POS cashier login repair
release_slices.name: Authentication account switch and POS cashier login repair
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Prevents IMS/POS login sessions from keeping stale company/account choices after switching users and clarifies POS cashier login paths.
release_slices.purpose: Repair account replacement and POS terminal login behavior while preserving CSRF enforcement, governed DGFY membership checks, terminal/location gates, and the separately labelled legacy grace path.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Resets stale identity/company selection during login account changes, adjusts the credentialed auth rate-limit window documentation and behavior, removes the confusing standalone POS tenant-local cashier login action from the locked terminal flow, keeps DGFY sign-in and legacy grace login distinct, updates ADR and tenant-management docs, and adds focused backend/frontend regression coverage.
included_features: IMS login identity reset when a different account replaces the current session
POS locked-terminal DGFY sign-in and legacy grace login labeling cleanup
Regression tests for account switching, public-auth request policy, POS terminal lock drawer contract, and rate limiter behavior
excluded_features: Checkout totals, payment handling, fiscal receipt calculation, and tenant lifecycle changes
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: Login/session reset and POS terminal-lock behavior may regress if a valid operator loses the intended company context or if the legacy grace path is hidden incorrectly.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: IMS login account replacement and company-selection persistence
POS locked terminal sign-in and legacy grace login entry points
DGFY membership-based company selection after account switch
